snippet.title: Truckful - Official Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
A new trailer for this whimsical single-player delivery adventure from Mythic Owl Games made its debut in the FGS Live From gamescom latam 2025 showcase. This cutesy truck driving game is part-platformer, part-exploration, part-horror (yeah, kinda!), with your little truck feeling from giant monster rigs down rickety roads, with a nod to Steven Spielberg’s 1971 classic Duel. Truckfui is coming to PC.
